description: This file defines the Zend_Validate_EmailAddress class, which provides email address validation according to RFC2822, including hostname and MX record checks, with configurable options.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_EmailAddress
classes.description: A class for validating email addresses with hostname and MX record checks, supporting various validation options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes validation options, accepting arrays or Zend_Config objects.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets multiple validation options, including messages, hostname validator, MX check, deep check, and domain check.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets a custom validation failure message for a specific key.

methods.name: setHostnameValidator
methods.description: Sets the hostname validator with optional allow parameter.

methods.name: validateMxSupported
methods.description: Checks if getmxrr DNS function is supported on the system.

methods.name: getValidateMx
methods.description: Returns whether MX record validation is enabled.

methods.name: setValidateMx
methods.description: Enables or disables MX record validation, throwing exception if unsupported.

methods.name: getDeepMxCheck
methods.description: Returns whether deep MX check is enabled.

methods.name: setDeepMxCheck
methods.description: Enables or disables deep MX record validation.

methods.name: getDomainCheck
methods.description: Returns whether domain validation is enabled.

methods.name: _isReserved
methods.description: Checks if a host IP is reserved or in a non-routable segment.

methods.name: _toIp
methods.description: Converts a binary string to an IP address array.

methods.name: _validateLocalPart
methods.description: Validates the local part of the email address against dot-atom and quoted-string formats.

methods.name: _validateMXRecords
methods.description: Validates MX records for the hostname, including deep DNS checks if enabled.

methods.name: _validateHostnamePart
methods.description: Validates the hostname part of the email address using hostname validator and MX checks.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Main validation method that checks if the email address is valid according to RFC2822, including format, local part, hostname, and MX records.
